text: Computer vision is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is shown in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key task is object detection, where the computer finds and locates several objects in the same image. These technologies have many practical applications in our daily lives. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to recognise road signs, pedestrians, and other vehicles. Hospitals also use it to study medical images. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more useful in many industries.
